newsitem.title: USA: U Mich consumer sentiment 106.4 July preliminary.
newsitem.headline: U Mich consumer sentiment 106.4 July preliminary.

text.p: The University of Michigan's preliminary index of consumer sentiment for July rose to 106.4 compared to 104.5 in the final June report, financial market sources said on Friday.
The current conditions component rose to 116.2 in the preliminary July report from 113.2 in the final June. The expectations index rose to 100.1 in the July report versus 98.9 in the final June.
The data are released only to paying subscribers.
